query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE status
                                      WHEN 'ready' THEN bytes
                                      WHEN 'processing' THEN bytes
                                      WHEN 'uploading' THEN COALESCE(declared_bytes, 0)
                                      ELSE 0
                                  END), 0)::bigint AS "total!"
               FROM media_assets WHERE owner_id = $1
